description: Submit against one of the open tasks. The payload is checked against that task's own criterion. A passing submission is counted as a foreign work in project100_kpi and pays one entitlement (0.1 RACOIN, vests in 20 days). A failing one counts as nothing — deliberately, so the number stays honest.

payload.description: The fields the task asks for, exactly as listed under abgabe.felder.

task_id.description: Task id from project100_tasks, e.g. two-doors.

name: project100_task_submit
